thread:
Anna C.: FYI renewal for Meridian Health (MER-109). Customer wants an unusual split: 6mo upfront commit billed via PO, then monthly for the rest. They also asked for a credit note for unused seats from the first invoice instead of prorating. Procurement insists PO covers the entire committed amount. Also request: delegated signer (director-level) rather than the default exec. Need alignment on billing + signature path.

Mike R.: quick question — do we have an active renewal quote that reflects the split, or is this a verbal ask? need the numbers to see invoice flow. :thinking_face:

Anna C.: Quote sent last week, I'll paste numbers: 6mo upfront = $120k (committed), monthly thereafter = $20k/mo. They will provision 50 seats now, might drop to 40 after month 2. They want the unused 10 seats credited back on first invoice rather than us prorating future invoices.

Sam F.: On the finance side — we typically either prorate the initial charge or issue a credit note after the event. Credit notes are ok but they require a follow-up reference (PO number + approved credit memo). If Procurement will only sign a PO for the full committed amount, issuing a subsequent credit is the normal route. It does add reconciliation work for them though.

Taylor S.: Customer preference is credit note (they said their internal team prefers credits for budget timing). They can sign the PO for the full committed amount today if we accept credit on the first invoice.

Julia L.: Delegated signer okay, but we need proof of delegation (email from authorized signer or a delegation-of-signature form) before finalizing. Also want the amendment to include a clause: "credit note issuance will not change the original PO value; credits will be applied to subsequent invoices" — helps legal/finance.

Mike R.: Idea: create a short amendment (1 page) that lists: committed amount, billing cadence, credit note policy, delegated signer acceptance conditions. Send as DocuSign with a checkbox for "authorize delegated signer". That should satisfy legal and procurement.

Anna C.: Sounds good. Sam — can finance handle the credit memo and link it to the PO? Also timeline: customer wants invoice issuance tomorrow to hit their month-end.

Sam F.: We can issue the invoice tomorrow for the full $120k. We can create a credit note for up to $24k (10 seats for 1mo) once they confirm seat reduction; will attach to the original invoice as a credit memo referencing invoice id and PO. Need PO number and delegated signer confirmation email before issuing credit. Processing note: credit memos take 2 business days to post.

finance-bot: Automated check: PO number missing — invoice creation blocked until PO is attached in Billing portal. See https://billing.redwood.ai/po-upload :warning:

Taylor S.: I'll get PO today and push for delegation email. I'll also confirm exact drop date for seats.

Anna C.: Draft amendment snippet I propose (copy/paste):
```
Amendment to Master Services Agreement - Meridian Health
1) Term: 12 months starting 2025-03-01; first 6 months paid upfront as per PO #XXXXX.
2) Billing: Upfront invoice for committed seats; thereafter monthly invoices for active seats.
3) Credit policy: Customer may request credit for permanently removed seats within 30 days of removal. Credits will be issued as credit memos applied to future invoices and will not alter the original PO amount.
4) Delegated Signer: Customer confirms an authorized delegated signer for this amendment by email to legal@redwood.ai; Redwood accepts delegated signers provided delegation email includes signer's name, title, and effective date.
```

Julia L.: Looks good. Add: "Credit memos are subject to verification of seat removal in our usage logs." Then legal signs off.

Sam F.: Add invoice reference line so credit memo ties back: "Credit memos will reference Invoice ID and PO # for reconciliation."

Mike R.: I'll assemble the amendment, create the DocuSign envelope with the checkbox for delegation and the PO upload field. Anna — can you confirm the PO number when Taylor posts it?

Anna C.: Yep — will attach as soon as Taylor posts. Taylor, please paste PO number in thread when you have it so finance-bot stops blocking. :pray:

Taylor S.: PO uploaded: PO-987654. Sending delegation email now (cc'ing legal). Also confirmed seat drop effective 2025-03-15.

finance-bot: PO received: PO-987654. Invoice creation allowed. Generating Invoice INV-20250301-3412...

Sam F.: Invoice created (INV-20250301-3412) for $120,000. We'll watch for a seat reduction event and issue credit memo up to $24,000 referencing INV-20250301-3412 and PO-987654 once delegation email is confirmed. Expect credit memo posted by 2025-03-17 if all docs arrive promptly.

Anna C.: Thanks team — moving to action. I'll send the DocuSign link to the customer after Mike uploads the amendment. Closing loop once signed. :white_check_mark:
